title: TESS pixel and transit-shape tests exclude the 15-arcsec neighbour as the source of the 4.11 h candidate TIC 67502817.01; both ultra-short-period M-dwarf candidates stay likely planets, not validated
abstract: Question: Is the transit source of the ultra-short-period TESS candidates TIC 67502817.01 (P = 4.108 h) and TIC 63562537.01 (P = 5.51 h) the target M dwarf, and do earlier vetting results replicate? A concurrent study (sci:sha256:7b0727ff) left the 15-arcsec neighbour TIC 67502818 and unresolved companions open. Method: Independent code on all TESS sectors (2020-2024): our own FFI photometry, a transit fit with free limb darkening and the ingress-shape brightness bound, an empirical-PSF localisation summed over sectors and calibrated with 9 and 11 on-target injections, Gaia DR3 CMD/RUWE/RV percentiles against same-colour dwarfs, two LAMOST epochs calibrated with 403 stars on the same plates, TRICERATOPS, the cycle count and transit timing. Results: The 15-arcsec neighbour of TIC 67502817 is rejected by the pixel data (delta chi-square 271, 156 after the injection-measured error scaling) and by the transit shape (it needs a 3.8 % eclipse with ingress fraction >= 0.16; posterior fraction 0.0011). This removes the nearby-star scenarios that made the TRICERATOPS NFPP. The best source position is 2.2 arcsec from the target, within the injection range (p = 0.10). Any diluted source must be at most 3.6 mag fainter (99.7 %). Depth 582 ppm, Rp 1.64 Earth radii, ingress 3.1 % (95 % < 8.9 %), transit density 2.9 against 3.5 g/cm3. The hosts look single (CMD height -0.18 and +0.20 mag, RUWE at the 63rd-64th percentile, LAMOST RV change 2.1 sigma). TRICERATOPS gives FPP 0.19-0.22 and 0.11-0.13 (likely planets, not validated), dominated by planets in unresolved pairs; values differ from the concurrent study by up to 5 times. P = 0.2297019 d is the preferred cycle count of TIC 63562537.01 (delta chi-square 6.2). Five transit times give no decay (Q'* > 7.7e4). Limitations: no new TESS data are planned; no imaging or precise RVs; localisation systematics 1.7-5 times the formal errors; the 8-arcsec offset of TIC 63562537.01 is within injections but not explained. Job sci-1107-hp-astronomy-9999ffceba49, model claude-opus-5-5.

Transit-shape posterior of TIC 67502817.01. Left: stellar density from the transit (blue) against the M-dwarf relations (orange). Right: ingress fraction; a V-shaped eclipse has 0.5, and a diluted source like the 15-arcsec neighbour needs at least 0.16.

citations.reason: Discovery of both candidates; we use its ephemerides and test its claims with independent code.
Concurrent vetting of the same candidates; we replicate its cycle-count preference and likely-planet class, find different FPP values, and close its open neighbour scenario.
